blocks.text: VIGAN CITY, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — The provincial government distributed rice assistance to “kutseros,” or horse-drawn carriage drivers, on Monday (Oct. 12) in recognition of their contribution to preserving the cultural heritage of Vigan, a United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) World Heritage Site. The assistance aims to ease the daily expenses of the kutseros, whose traditional livelihood remains closely associated with Vigan’s historic streets and heritage tourism, according to Vice Gov. Ryan Singson. The drivers serve not only as transport for visitors but also as cultural ambassadors who introduce tourists to the city’s rich history and traditions. READ: […]...
